verdict.rationale: Postman offers a programmatic Postman API (docs-5) and an OpenAPI spec (probe-3), so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents API versioning or a deprecation policy for that API. The workspace 'version' mention (docs-18) is about users versioning their own work, and the 'latest-v-12' doc URLs refer to app documentation versions; both are adjacent features that earn no credit.
